spaced: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

spaced: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
translation: Raag Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House:

spaced: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਊਸਰਹਿ ਰਤਨੀ ਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
translation: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,

spaced: ਕਸਤੂਰਿ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਰਿ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਲੀਪਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
translation: scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold

spaced: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
translation: -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.

spaced: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਧਰਤੀ ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਤੀ ਪਲਘਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
translation: If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed was encased with rubies,

spaced: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
translation: and if heavenly beauties, their faces adorned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love

spaced: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||

spaced: ਸਿਧੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਈ ਰਿਧਿ ਆਖਾ ਆਉ ॥
translation: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth

spaced: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
translation: and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe

spaced: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
translation: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||3||

spaced: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਉ ॥
translation: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,

spaced: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥
translation: issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puff of wind.

spaced: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
translation: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||4||1||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥
translation: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,

spaced: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸਉਣ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
translation: and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams

spaced: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
translation: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||1||

spaced: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
translation: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.

spaced: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord, please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਣਿ ਪੀਸਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill and ground into flour,

spaced: ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੀਆ ਭਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes

spaced: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||

spaced: ਪੰਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇ ਭਵਾ ਸੈ ਅਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,

spaced: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਵਊ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੀਆ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥
translation: and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything

spaced: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
translation: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||3||

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਗਦ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
translation: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,

spaced: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਚਲਾਉ ॥
translation: and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind

spaced: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
translation: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||4||2||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
translation: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consume their food.

spaced: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਾਉ ॥
translation: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.

spaced: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
translation: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholars about this? ||1||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਨਾ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
translation: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.

spaced: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
translation: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.

spaced: ਜਿਥੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.

spaced: ਰੋਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.

spaced: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.

spaced: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥੩॥
translation: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds. ||3||

spaced: ਨੀਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਨੀਚੀ ਹੂ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੀਸ ॥
translation: Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low.

spaced: ਜਿਥੈ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
translation: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਠਗਿ ਖਾਧਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass.

spaced: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ॥
translation: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.

spaced: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
translation: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.

spaced: ਊਤਮ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
translation: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of the fragrance of sandalwood,

spaced: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
translation: the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals

spaced: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
translation: -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
translation: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.

spaced: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜਾਣ ॥
translation: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!

spaced: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿ ਕਹਣ ਵਖਾਣ ॥੩॥
translation: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਅਵਰ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਕਾਇ ॥
translation: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਦਾਨਿ ਨ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
translation: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਅਮਲੁ ਗਲੋਲਾ ਕੂੜ ਕਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.

spaced: ਮਤੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਫੀਆ ਰਾਖਣ ਕਉ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
translation: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਗੁੜ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
translation: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.

spaced: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.

spaced: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||

spaced: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
translation: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,

spaced: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
translation: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

spaced: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||

spaced: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
translation: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?

spaced: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
translation: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.

spaced: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
translation: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.

spaced: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.

spaced: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
translation: O Baba, write such an account,

spaced: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥
translation: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
translation: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.

spaced: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
translation: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||

spaced: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
translation: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.

spaced: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥
translation: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.

spaced: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
translation: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||

spaced: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
translation: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.

spaced: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
translation: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
translation: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥
translation: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;

spaced: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥
translation: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.

spaced: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
translation: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.

spaced: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
translation: Erasing the blackness of sin is my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.

spaced: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
translation: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.

spaced: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
translation: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.

spaced: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
translation: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.

spaced: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
translation: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
translation: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
translation: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

spaced: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
translation: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

spaced: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
translation: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥
translation: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

spaced: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
translation: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

spaced: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
translation: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

spaced: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

spaced: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

spaced: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

spaced: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

spaced: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
translation: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
translation: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
translation: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

spaced: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

spaced: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
translation: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥
translation: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥
translation: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
translation: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
translation: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

spaced: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
translation: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

spaced: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
translation: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

spaced: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
translation: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
translation: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
translation: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
translation: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

spaced: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
translation: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

spaced: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
translation: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

spaced: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
translation: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

spaced: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
translation: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?"

spaced: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥
translation: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

spaced: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
translation: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad." ||2||

spaced: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
translation: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

spaced: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
translation: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

spaced: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
translation: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

spaced: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
translation: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
translation: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

spaced: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
translation: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

spaced: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
translation: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

spaced: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

spaced: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

spaced: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
translation: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

spaced: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
translation: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

spaced: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

spaced: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
translation: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
translation: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

spaced: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
translation: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

spaced: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

spaced: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

spaced: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

spaced: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
translation: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
translation: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

spaced: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

spaced: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
translation: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

spaced: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
translation: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

spaced: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
translation: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

spaced: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
translation: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

spaced: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

spaced: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

spaced: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
translation: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

spaced: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
translation: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

spaced: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
translation: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

spaced: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
translation: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

spaced: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
translation: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
translation: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

spaced: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
translation: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

spaced: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

spaced: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

spaced: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
translation: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

spaced: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

spaced: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
translation: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

spaced: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
translation: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

spaced: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
translation: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

spaced: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
translation: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
translation: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

spaced: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
translation: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
translation: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

spaced: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
translation: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

spaced: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

spaced: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
translation: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

spaced: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.

spaced: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
translation: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

spaced: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

spaced: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
translation: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
translation: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

spaced: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
translation: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

spaced: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
translation: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
translation: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
translation: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

spaced: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
translation: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
translation: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

spaced: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
translation: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
translation: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
translation: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

spaced: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
translation: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
translation: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
translation: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

spaced: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

spaced: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
translation: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
translation: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

spaced: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
translation: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
translation: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
translation: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

spaced: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
translation: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
translation: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

spaced: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

spaced: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
translation: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

spaced: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

spaced: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
translation: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

spaced: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
translation: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

spaced: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
translation: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

spaced: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
translation: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

spaced: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
translation: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
translation: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
translation: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

spaced: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
translation: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

spaced: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
translation: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

spaced: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

spaced: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

spaced: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
translation: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

spaced: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
translation: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
translation: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

spaced: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

spaced: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
translation: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
translation: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

spaced: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
translation: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
translation: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

spaced: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

spaced: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||

spaced: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
translation: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
translation: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
translation: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
translation: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.

spaced: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
translation: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.

spaced: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
translation: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
translation: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.

spaced: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
translation: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.

spaced: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
translation: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
translation: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
translation: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
translation: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
translation: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

spaced: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
translation: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
translation: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

spaced: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

spaced: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
translation: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

spaced: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
translation: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
translation: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
translation: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
translation: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.

spaced: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: Buy that object which will go along with you.

spaced: ਅਗੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
translation: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

spaced: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

spaced: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

spaced: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

spaced: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

spaced: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
translation: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
translation: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

spaced: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

spaced: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
translation: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

spaced: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
translation: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

spaced: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
translation: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

spaced: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
translation: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

spaced: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

spaced: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
translation: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

spaced: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
translation: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

spaced: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
translation: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
translation: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
translation: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

spaced: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
translation: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
translation: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

spaced: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
translation: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
translation: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
translation: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

spaced: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
translation: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

spaced: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

spaced: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
translation: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

spaced: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
translation: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

spaced: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
translation: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

spaced: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
translation: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

spaced: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
translation: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

spaced: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
translation: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||

spaced: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣ ਸਹਿ ਗਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
translation: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

spaced: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
translation: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

spaced: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
translation: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

spaced: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
translation: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

spaced: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
translation: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

spaced: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
translation: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

spaced: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
translation: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

spaced: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
translation: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||

spaced: ਮਰਣਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
translation: Death, O Mullah-death will come,

spaced: ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਹੁ ਡਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
translation: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

spaced: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
translation: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

spaced: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
translation: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

spaced: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
translation: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

spaced: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
translation: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
translation: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

spaced: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸੁਆਨੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: The dogs of greed are with me.

spaced: ਭਲਕੇ ਭਉਕਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਇਆਲਿ ॥
translation: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.

spaced: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੁਰਾ ਮੁਠਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.

spaced: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

spaced: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
translation: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.

spaced: ਹਉ ਬਿਗੜੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
translation: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.

spaced: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

spaced: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਆਖਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
translation: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.

spaced: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥
translation: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!

spaced: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
translation: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.

spaced: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||

spaced: ਫਾਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਲੂਕੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
translation: I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.

spaced: ਹਉ ਠਗਵਾੜਾ ਠਗੀ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
translation: I am a robber-I rob the world.

spaced: ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
translation: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.

spaced: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੩॥
translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||

spaced: ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੁ ॥
translation: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

spaced: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
translation: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.

spaced: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੨੯॥
translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

spaced: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ॥
translation: There is one awareness among all created beings.

spaced: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਅ ॥
translation: None have been created without this awareness.

spaced: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
translation: As is their awareness, so is their way.

spaced: ਲੇਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
translation: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

spaced: ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
translation: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?

spaced: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
translation: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,

spaced: ਕਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
translation: how can You become angry with them?

spaced: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
translation: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,

spaced: ਤੂ ਓਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਓਹਿ ॥੨॥
translation: still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||

spaced: ਅਸੀ ਬੋਲਵਿਗਾੜ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
translation: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.

spaced: ਤੂ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥
translation: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.

spaced: ਜਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
translation: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.

spaced: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?

spaced: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: They are self-realized; they understand God.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;

spaced: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੦॥
translation: such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

spaced: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
translation: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?

spaced: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
translation: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||

spaced: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
translation: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.

spaced: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਤੂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.

spaced: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.

spaced: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
translation: You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.

spaced: ਤੇਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||

spaced: ਜੇਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਹਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
translation: Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.

spaced: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?

spaced: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
translation: Nanak offers this one prayer:

spaced: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
translation: this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
translation: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
translation: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.

spaced: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
translation: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

spaced: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?

spaced: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
translation: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.

spaced: ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.

spaced: ਕੀਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
translation: What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ॥
translation: He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.

spaced: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਆਰਾਉ ॥
translation: The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden

spaced: ਜੇਹੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
translation: according to their nature, He gives them all their names.

spaced: ਫੁਲੁ ਭਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||

spaced: ਕਚੀ ਕੰਧ ਕਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜੁ ॥
translation: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.

spaced: ਮਤਿ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
translation: The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਣੇ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
translation: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.
Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:

spaced: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
translation: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
translation: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥ ਭਉ ਵਟੀ ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
translation: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil,

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਆਣਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
translation: Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਇਉ ਜਲੈ ॥
translation: Use this oil to light this lamp.

spaced: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
translation: This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;

spaced: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
translation: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

spaced: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
translation: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

spaced: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
translation: In the midst of this world, do seva,

spaced: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
translation: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

spaced: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
translation: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

spaced: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

spaced: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
translation: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

spaced: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

spaced: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

spaced: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

spaced: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

spaced: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
translation: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

spaced: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
translation: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
translation: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

spaced: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
translation: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

spaced: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

spaced: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

spaced: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
translation: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

spaced: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.

spaced: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.

spaced: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.

spaced: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

spaced: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.

spaced: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.

spaced: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
translation: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.

spaced: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||

spaced: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
translation: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.

spaced: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
translation: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
translation: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.

spaced: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
translation: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.

spaced: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
translation: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.

spaced: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
translation: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.

spaced: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
