translation: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

spaced: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥
translation: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
translation: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
translation: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

spaced: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
translation: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.

spaced: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.

spaced: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

spaced: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

spaced: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
translation: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.

spaced: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.

spaced: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.

spaced: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.

spaced: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||

spaced: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.

spaced: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

spaced: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.

spaced: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.

spaced: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||

spaced: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

spaced: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
translation: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
translation: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

spaced: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

spaced: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
translation: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

spaced: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
translation: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
translation: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
translation: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
translation: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

spaced: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

spaced: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
translation: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.

spaced: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥
translation: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
translation: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.

spaced: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
translation: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||

spaced: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.

spaced: ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
translation: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥
translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
translation: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
translation: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
translation: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.

spaced: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
translation: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||

spaced: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
translation: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.

spaced: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
translation: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.

spaced: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
translation: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.

spaced: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥
translation: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.

spaced: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.

spaced: ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.

spaced: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.

spaced: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.

spaced: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.

spaced: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||

spaced: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.

spaced: ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥
translation: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਾਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
translation: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.

spaced: ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
translation: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
translation: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
translation: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.

spaced: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
translation: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
translation: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.

spaced: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
translation: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.

spaced: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
translation: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||

spaced: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

spaced: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
translation: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੫॥
translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.

spaced: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.

spaced: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.

spaced: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.

spaced: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.

spaced: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.

spaced: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
translation: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੬॥
translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
translation: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.

spaced: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
translation: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||

spaced: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.

spaced: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
translation: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||

spaced: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
translation: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥
translation: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
translation: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.

spaced: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
translation: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
translation: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?

spaced: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
translation: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.

spaced: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
translation: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
translation: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||

spaced: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
translation: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
translation: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||

spaced: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
translation: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥
translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace.

spaced: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
translation: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
translation: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.

spaced: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||

spaced: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.

spaced: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
translation: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.

spaced: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
translation: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥
translation: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.

spaced: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.

spaced: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.

spaced: ਪੀਵਤ ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.

spaced: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.

spaced: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||

spaced: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥
translation: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.

spaced: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||

spaced: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
translation: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.

spaced: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
translation: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.

spaced: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
translation: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥
translation: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
translation: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
translation: O mind, give up the love of duality.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.

spaced: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਦਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
translation: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

spaced: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

spaced: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

spaced: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
translation: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

spaced: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
translation: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

spaced: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
translation: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

spaced: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
translation: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

spaced: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.

spaced: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥
translation: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.

spaced: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
translation: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.

spaced: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.

spaced: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

spaced: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||

spaced: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
translation: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.

spaced: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||

spaced: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.

spaced: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੪॥
translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Consider the time and the moment-when should we worship the Lord?

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.

spaced: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
translation: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.

spaced: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||

spaced: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.

spaced: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||

spaced: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
translation: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥
translation: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

spaced: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

spaced: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.

spaced: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

spaced: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
translation: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

spaced: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
translation: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.

spaced: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
translation: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.

spaced: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

spaced: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?

spaced: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.

spaced: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
translation: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||

spaced: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, the disease is not cured, and the pain of egotism is not removed.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, He dwells in the mind, and one remains immersed in His Name.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found; without the Shabad, people wander, deceived by doubt. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O mind, dwell in the balanced state of your own inner being.

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Praise the Lord's Name, and you shall no longer come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: The One Lord alone is the Giver, pervading everywhere. There is no other at all.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Praise the Word of the Shabad, and He shall come to dwell in your mind; you shall be blessed with intuitive peace and poise.

spaced: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Everything is within the Lord's Glance of Grace. As He wishes, He gives. ||2||

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਾ ਗਣਤ ਹੈ ਗਣਤੈ ਨਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
translation: In egotism, all must account for their actions. In this accounting, there is no peace.

spaced: ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: Acting in evil and corruption, people are immersed in corruption.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Without the Name, they find no place of rest. In the City of Death, they suffer in agony. ||3||

spaced: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Body and soul all belong to Him; He is the Support of all.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, understanding comes, and then the Door of Liberation is found.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੭॥
translation: O Nanak, sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has no end or limitation. ||4||24||57||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਤਿਨਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Those who have the Support of the True Name are in ecstasy and peace forever.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they obtain the True One, the Destroyer of pain.

spaced: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the True Name.

spaced: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, He bestows the treasure of devotion. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
translation: O mind, sing His Glorious Praises, and be in ecstasy forever.

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Through the True Word of His Bani, the Lord is obtained, and one remains immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: In true devotion, the mind is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love, with intuitive peace and poise.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The mind is fascinated by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, which cannot be described.

spaced: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
translation: The tongue imbued with the True Word of the Shabad drinks in the Amrit with delight, singing His Glorious Praises.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: The Gurmukh obtains this love, when the Lord, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||2||

spaced: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
translation: This world is an illusion; people pass their life-nights sleeping.

spaced: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, He lifts some out, and unites them with Himself.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
translation: He Himself abides in the mind, and drives out attachment to Maya.

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: He Himself bestows glorious greatness; He inspires the Gurmukh to understand. ||3||

spaced: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਲਏ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all. He corrects those who make mistakes.

spaced: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਛਡਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: He Himself has deceived some, and attached them to duality.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is found, and one's light merges into the Light.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੮॥
translation: Attuned to the Name of the Lord night and day, O Nanak, you shall be absorbed into the Name. ||4||25||58||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
translation: The virtuous obtain Truth; they give up their desires for evil and corruption.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: Their minds are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Love of their Beloved is on their tongues.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
translation: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.

spaced: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himself ushers them into His Presence. ||2||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗਣਿ ਰੰਗਿਓਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, He unites us with Himself.

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.

spaced: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, but they do not understand.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

spaced: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be able to end my suffering.

spaced: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains a reputation of Truth.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥
translation: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Him again. ||4||26||59||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himself watches over it.

spaced: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
translation: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those who remain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

spaced: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unites them with Himself. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.

spaced: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, we contemplate Him.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
translation: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism from within.

spaced: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||

spaced: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.

spaced: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
translation: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean of demerits.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥
translation: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਾਮ ਗਹੇਲੀਏ ਕਿਆ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਇ ॥
translation: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk like that, swinging your arms in joy?

spaced: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face will you show Him?

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖਂੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1||

spaced: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.

spaced: ਪਿਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spend their life-night?

spaced: ਗਰਬਿ ਅਟੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love of duality.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated from within.

spaced: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissful peace. ||2||

spaced: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.

spaced: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and her hunger does not depart.

spaced: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she is absorbed in the True One. ||3||

spaced: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.

spaced: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
translation: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering before Him.

spaced: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥
translation: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they are absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
translation: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
translation: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His Constant Presence. ||1||

spaced: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into the True One. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.

spaced: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
translation: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowing with the treasure of devotion.

spaced: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||

spaced: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥
translation: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
translation: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥
translation: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without the Guru, they do not find You.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits and administers True Justice.

spaced: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਓਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ॥
translation: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.

spaced: ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

spaced: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma serves them; blessed is the Lord who adorns them. ||2||

spaced: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਤਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: One who eliminates mental wickedness from within the mind, and casts out emotional attachment and egotistical pride,

spaced: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: comes to recognize the All-pervading Soul, and is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਵਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Without the True Guru, the self-willed manmukhs do not find liberation; they wander around like lunatics.

spaced: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
translation: They do not contemplate the Shabad; engrossed in corruption, they utter only empty words. ||3||

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: He Himself is everything; there is no other at all.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: I speak just as He makes me speak, when He Himself makes me speak.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The Word of the Gurmukh is God Himself. Through the Shabad, we merge in Him.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੩॥
translation: O Nanak, remember the Naam; serving Him, peace is obtained. ||4||30||63||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਜਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The world is polluted with the filth of egotism, suffering in pain. This filth sticks to them because of their love of duality.

spaced: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
translation: This filth of egotism cannot be washed away, even by taking cleansing baths at hundreds of sacred shrines.

spaced: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥
translation: Performing all sorts of rituals, people are smeared with twice as much filth.

spaced: ਪੜਿਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: This filth is not removed by studying. Go ahead, and ask the wise ones. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, coming to the Sanctuary of the Guru, you shall become immaculate and pure.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, but their filth cannot be removed. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: With a polluted mind, devotional service cannot be performed, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be obtained.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: The filthy, self-willed manmukhs die in filth, and they depart in disgrace.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and the filth of egotism is dispelled.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਲੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Like a lamp lit in the darkness, the spiritual wisdom of the Guru dispels ignorance. ||2||

spaced: ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹਗੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
translation: "I have done this, and I will do that" - I am an idiotic fool for saying this!

spaced: ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: I have forgotten the Doer of all; I am caught in the love of duality.

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
translation: There is no pain as great as the pain of Maya; it drives people to wander all around the world, until they become exhausted.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace is found, with the True Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

spaced: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meet and merge with the Lord.

spaced: ਏ ਮਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥
translation: This mind is attuned to devotional worship; through the True Word of Gurbani, it finds its own home.

spaced: ਮਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਚੇ ਗਾਉ ॥
translation: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੪॥
translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, First House:

spaced: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?

spaced: ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.

spaced: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: I go and ask my friends, "How can I meet and merge with God?" ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.

spaced: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite me with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meet Him.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.

spaced: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
translation: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united me with God. ||2||

spaced: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort.

spaced: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.

spaced: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||

spaced: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
translation: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
translation: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.

spaced: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਢਿ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥
translation: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
translation: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.

spaced: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
translation: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.

spaced: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
translation: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
translation: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
translation: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.

spaced: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੀਆ ਜੋ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||

spaced: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲ ॥
translation: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.

spaced: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
translation: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.

spaced: ਓਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਦੁਆਸਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
translation: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.

spaced: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
translation: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.

spaced: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥
translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

spaced: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
translation: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

spaced: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
translation: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.

spaced: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
translation: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ॥
translation: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਬੂਡਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
translation: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.

spaced: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬੭॥
translation: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

spaced: ਹਉ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
translation: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.

spaced: ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
translation: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.

spaced: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
translation: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.

spaced: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
translation: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.

spaced: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਊ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
translation: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
translation: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is not obtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.

spaced: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੬੮॥
translation: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

spaced: ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get to taste this essence?

spaced: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
translation: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, "How did you come to meet God?"

spaced: ਓਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਬੋਲਨੀ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your spiritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

spaced: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdue your ego. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਦਇਆ ਪਈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਚਨੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

spaced: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, are known as great and very fortunate. ||2||

spaced: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, but the unfortunate ones do not taste it.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry in misery.

spaced: ਓਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is the Essence.

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੋਇ ॥
translation: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬੯॥
translation: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

spaced: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਚੜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.

spaced: ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਨਰੁ ਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਇ ॥
translation: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life.

spaced: ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਗਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly, rotting away. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.

spaced: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
