translation: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||

spaced: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣਹੀਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੇਹਿ ॥
translation: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?

spaced: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਣਸੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥
translation: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥੋੜੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
translation: like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.

spaced: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
translation: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||

spaced: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
translation: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.

spaced: ਤਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
translation: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we are enraptured.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
translation: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||

spaced: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖੋਟੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.

spaced: ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਜਲੀ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ॥
translation: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood and corruption.

spaced: ਆਵਣੁ ਵੰਞਣੁ ਡਾਖੜੋ ਛੋਡੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
translation: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten by her Husband Lord. ||4||

spaced: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਤੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
translation: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she been doomed?

spaced: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਬੋਲੇ ਫਾਦਿਲੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
translation: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.

spaced: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੫॥
translation: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||

spaced: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਚਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand the real meaning.

spaced: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮਤੀ ਦੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
translation: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Maya themselves.

spaced: ਕਥਨੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ਰਹਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
translation: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true to the Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||

spaced: ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.

spaced: ਵਾਦਿ ਵਿਰੋਧਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੇ ਵਾਦੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
translation: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continue coming and going.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
translation: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak and listen and preach and explain. ||7||

spaced: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੫॥
translation: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
translation: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell at sacred shrines of pilgrimage;

spaced: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
translation: you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the True One, what is the use of it all?

spaced: ਜੇਹਾ ਰਾਧੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਲੁਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
translation: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain. ||1||

spaced: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.

spaced: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbed into the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Without capital, the trader looks around in all four directions.

spaced: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
translation: He does not understand his own origins; the merchandise remains within the door of his own house.

spaced: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਖਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||

spaced: ਲਾਹਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਉਤਨਾ ਪਰਖੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.

spaced: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
translation: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.

spaced: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
translation: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||

spaced: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.

spaced: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
translation: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.

spaced: ਸਚੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੪॥
translation: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
translation: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.

spaced: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
translation: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

spaced: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
translation: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

spaced: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
translation: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੬॥
translation: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

spaced: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਾ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

spaced: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
translation: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

spaced: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
translation: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

spaced: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਧਾਊਆ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

spaced: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
translation: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
translation: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

spaced: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
translation: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.

spaced: ਸਹਜੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.

spaced: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.

spaced: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
translation: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.

spaced: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
translation: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||

spaced: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.

spaced: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
translation: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.

spaced: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||

spaced: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਖੇ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.

spaced: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.

spaced: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||

spaced: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.

spaced: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.

spaced: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
translation: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||

spaced: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਆਸੁ ॥
translation: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,

spaced: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
translation: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
translation: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||

spaced: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.

spaced: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
translation: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.

spaced: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੭॥
translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||

spaced: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਡਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.

spaced: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥
translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
translation: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
translation: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.

spaced: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
translation: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.

spaced: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
translation: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!

spaced: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.

spaced: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
translation: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my true home. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
translation: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find their place of rest.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
translation: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the use of it all?

spaced: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੩॥
translation: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਲਰ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
translation: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.

spaced: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
translation: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥
translation: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa. ||4||

spaced: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
translation: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੫॥
translation: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexual desire, anger, selfishness and conceit.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

spaced: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
translation: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
translation: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.

spaced: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੭॥
translation: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||

spaced: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀਐ ਕਹੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, what is accomplished?

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੮॥
translation: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਐ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Without her Husband, the soul-bride's youth and ornaments are useless and wretched.

spaced: ਨਾ ਮਾਣੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
translation: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments are absurd.

spaced: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: The discarded bride suffers terrible pain; her Husband does not come to the bed of her home. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, love is not found. United with the Shabad, happiness is found. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Serving the Guru, she finds peace, and her Husband Lord adorns her with intuitive wisdom.

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਗੂੜਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Truly, she enjoys the Bed of her Husband, through her deep love and affection.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਣ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: As Gurmukh, she comes to know Him. Meeting with the Guru, she maintains a virtuous lifestyle. ||2||

spaced: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband, enshrine love for Him.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot be described.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
translation: If the mind within the mind dies, then the Husband ravishes and enjoys His bride.

spaced: ਇਕਤੁ ਤਾਗੈ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: They are woven into one texture, like pearls on a necklace around the neck.

spaced: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
translation: In the Society of the Saints, peace wells up; the Gurmukhs take the Support of the Naam. ||4||

spaced: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿਨਿ ਖਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: In an instant, one is born, and in an instant, one dies. In an instant one comes, and in an instant one goes.

spaced: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਇ ॥
translation: One who recognizes the Shabad merges into it, and is not afflicted by death.

spaced: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
translation: Our Lord and Master is Unweighable; He cannot be weighed. He cannot be found merely by talking. ||5||

spaced: ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
translation: The merchants and the traders have come; their profits are pre-ordained.

spaced: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.

spaced: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
translation: With the Merchandise of Truth, they meet the Guru, who does not have a trace of greed. ||6||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
translation: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.

spaced: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
translation: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੭॥
translation: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||

spaced: ਕਥਨੈ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਭਾਰ ॥
translation: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.

spaced: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
translation: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੮॥੯॥
translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.

spaced: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

spaced: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਾਰਦੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.

spaced: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.

spaced: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
translation: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਸਾਚੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
translation: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.

spaced: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||

spaced: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਨਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The terrifying world-ocean is difficult and dreadful; there is no shore on this side or the one beyond.

spaced: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਵੰਝੁ ਮਲਾਰੁ ॥
translation: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੈ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
translation: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries us across. ||4||

spaced: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.

spaced: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਉ ਜਲਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
translation: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.

spaced: ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਜਮੁ ਪਕੜੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੫॥
translation: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||

spaced: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
translation: Crying out, "Mine! Mine!", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and their wives did not go with them.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਥਿ ॥
translation: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.

spaced: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੋ ਕਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
translation: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||

spaced: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.

spaced: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
translation: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with the Lord's Will.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
translation: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are united in His Union. ||7||

spaced: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong to Him.

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਲਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotistical pride consigned to the fire.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
translation: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਕਮਲੇਹਿ ॥
translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.

spaced: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਐ ਭੀ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ॥
translation: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.

spaced: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
translation: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
translation: O mind, how can you be saved without love?

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ॥
translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਅਧਿਕਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
translation: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind and body.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
translation: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||

spaced: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

spaced: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
translation: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?

spaced: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
translation: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives her head. ||3||

spaced: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.

spaced: ਆਵਟਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਣਿ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
translation: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk from burning.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
translation: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||

spaced: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ॥
translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.

spaced: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
translation: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinks that it is near.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
translation: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions of the Creator come to pass.

spaced: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.

spaced: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.

spaced: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
translation: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

spaced: ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ ਸਰ ਤਲਿ ॥
translation: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.

spaced: ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥
translation: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿ ॥੮॥
translation: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arena of Truth. ||8||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.

spaced: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
translation: One who recognizes within himself that, "He is me", and who is pierced through by the Shabad, is satisfied.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
translation: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to do or have done? ||9||

spaced: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
translation: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving the Shabad, they are satisfied.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endure beatings.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
translation: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all. ||10||11||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no place of rest.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ਅੰਧੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming and going.

spaced: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered. ||1||

spaced: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
translation: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.

spaced: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਰ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons her own home.

spaced: ਭੂਲੀ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਥਲਿ ਚੜੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.

spaced: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||

spaced: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
translation: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||

spaced: ਅਖਰ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.

spaced: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
translation: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||

spaced: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.

spaced: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

spaced: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
translation: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
translation: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||

spaced: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
translation: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

spaced: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
translation: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||

spaced: ਭੁਲਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
translation: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਘਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.

spaced: ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
translation: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

spaced: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
translation: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||

spaced: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.

spaced: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
translation: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

spaced: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
translation: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.

spaced: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
translation: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||

spaced: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.

spaced: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
translation: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.

spaced: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥
translation: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
translation: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||

spaced: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.

spaced: ਕਹਣੈ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||

spaced: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
translation: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੀਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
translation: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||

spaced: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.

spaced: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.

spaced: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਧਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੭॥
translation: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

spaced: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
translation: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. The Companionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੮॥
translation: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the True Lord. ||8||

spaced: ਆਕਾਸੀ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the three worlds.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
translation: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union with Yourself.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੩॥
translation: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
translation: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?

spaced: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
translation: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.

spaced: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਤਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਕਟਾਇ ॥
translation: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,

spaced: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
translation: and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in the fire,

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all these are not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||

spaced: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ ॥
translation: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,

spaced: ਤਨੁ ਹੈਮੰਚਲਿ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free of disease.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||

spaced: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਦਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
translation: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrous elephants in charity,

spaced: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਗਊਆ ਘਣੀ ਭੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
translation: and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still be within me.

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
translation: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift. ||4||

spaced: ਮਨਹਠ ਬੁਧੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
translation: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplate the Vedas.

spaced: ਕੇਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
translation: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gate of Liberation.

spaced: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
translation: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਊਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.

spaced: ਇਕਨੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
translation: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.

spaced: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
translation: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||

spaced: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.

spaced: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
translation: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.

spaced: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||7||

spaced: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, with sublime love for the Shabad.

spaced: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
translation: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
translation: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਚਿਤੇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਬਗੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
translation: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;

spaced: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.

spaced: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
translation: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.

spaced: ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
translation: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.

spaced: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.

spaced: ਨਾਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
translation: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
translation: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

spaced: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਵਣੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
translation: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search of transitory wealth, unstable and distracted.

spaced: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
translation: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in that sacred place within the home of the heart.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps. ||4||

spaced: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
translation: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!

spaced: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੋ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣੁ ॥
translation: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.

spaced: ਪਵਣੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
translation: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||

spaced: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮੁਆ ਨ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.

spaced: ਸੁਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.

spaced: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
translation: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Lord and Guru? ||6||

spaced: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
ਇਉ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
translation: just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filled with ego and duality.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੭॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world is just a dream. ||7||

spaced: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੂਧੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
translation: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਇ ॥
translation: and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
translation: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

spaced: ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡਰੀਆਸੁ ॥
translation: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.

spaced: ਊਚਉ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਗਾਖੜੋ ਨਾ ਪਉੜੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
translation: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਰੀਆਸੁ ॥੧॥
translation: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union, and so I cross over. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਂਉ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!

spaced: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me, through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਚਲਾ ਚਲਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: I may say, "I am going, I am going", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.

spaced: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.

spaced: ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
translation: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||

spaced: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਪਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
translation: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,

spaced: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
translation: elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies

spaced: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
translation: -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||

spaced: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਮਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
translation: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.

spaced: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
translation: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without the Name, death hovers over your head.

spaced: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਜੀਉ ਖੇਲਸੀ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
translation: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||

spaced: ਪੁਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਐ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰ ॥
translation: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.

spaced: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
translation: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.

spaced: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
translation: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||

spaced: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਈਐ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਉ ਕਿ ਖਾਨੁ ॥
translation: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;

spaced: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਉ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਜਲਿ ਬਲੀਐ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
translation: he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire of egotistical pride.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਵਿ ਦਧਾ ਕਾਨੁ ॥੬॥
translation: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in the forest fire. ||6||

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart.

spaced: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਆਹਿ ॥
translation: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.

spaced: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
translation: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of the Shabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
translation: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the heads of kings.

spaced: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
translation: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while the Gurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

spaced: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਧੋਖ ॥
translation: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to depart is always there.

spaced: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
translation: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable and unchanging. ||1||

spaced: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸਿ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ॥
translation: What sort of a resting place is this world?

spaced: ਕਰਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed to the Name. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਜੋਗੀ ਤ ਆਸਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਲਾ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਕਾਮਿ ॥
translation: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.

spaced: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਬਹਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
translation: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||

spaced: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
translation: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints, priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders

spaced: ਦਰਿ ਕੂਚ ਕੂਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਵਰੇ ਭਿ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
translation: -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||

spaced: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੂਚੁ ॥
translation: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.

spaced: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਦਿਲ ਸਮਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਭਿ ਪਹੂਚੁ ॥੪॥
translation: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must go as well! ||4||

spaced: ਸਬਦਾਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!

spaced: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air. ||5||

spaced: ਅਲਾਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਮੁ ॥
translation: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.

spaced: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ ॥੬॥
translation: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||

spaced: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
translation: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.

spaced: ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੭॥
translation: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||

spaced: ਦਿਨ ਰਵਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਲਖ ਪਲੋਇ ॥
translation: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.

spaced: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਗੋਇ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
translation: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17||

spaced: ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਤਾਰਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
translation: Seventeen Ashtpadheeyaa Of The First Mehl.

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

spaced: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

spaced: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
translation: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?

spaced: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
translation: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

spaced: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
translation: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
translation: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||

spaced: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
translation: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
translation: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||

spaced: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
translation: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
translation: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੪॥
translation: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall depart with regret in the end. ||4||

spaced: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
translation: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivated within my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
translation: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotional attachment are removed.

spaced: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
translation: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
translation: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
translation: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain are totally eliminated.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
translation: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||7||

spaced: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
translation: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, He abides within the mind.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੮॥
translation: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਮਡੰਡੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
translation: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Death with his club.

spaced: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
translation: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
translation: Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.

spaced: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||

spaced: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your past actions are still not erased.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਦਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door. ||3||

spaced: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਿੜਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.

spaced: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੀਐ ਭੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: Even if the poisonous plant is watered with ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||

spaced: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
translation: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego and corruption. ||5||

spaced: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and the Shaastras.

spaced: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of the Guru, you shall be saved. ||6||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
translation: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੯॥
translation: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.

spaced: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
translation: O mind, work to serve the Guru.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਊਡਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
translation: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.

spaced: ਜੇਤਾ ਊਡਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਤੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
translation: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
translation: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.

spaced: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.

spaced: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਊਭੇ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.

spaced: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਓਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਉ ॥
translation: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.

spaced: ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
translation: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||

spaced: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
translation: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.

spaced: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
translation: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.

spaced: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
translation: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

spaced: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
translation: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

spaced: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
translation: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.

spaced: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
translation: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
translation: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
translation: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.

spaced: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
translation: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||

spaced: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.

spaced: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
translation: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

spaced: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.

spaced: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.

spaced: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
translation: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
translation: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.

spaced: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge in Truth. ||4||

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
translation: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in the Samaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.

spaced: ਤੀਨੇ ਲੋਅ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਹੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
translation: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
translation: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya does not go away. ||5||

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
translation: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?

spaced: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
translation: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਨਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
translation: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within. ||6||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.

spaced: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya is dispelled.

spaced: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

spaced: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet that God with intuitive ease.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੧॥
translation: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained. ||8||4||21||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us through illusion and doubt.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.

spaced: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
translation: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.

spaced: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

spaced: ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
translation: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger of Death cannot devour us. ||2||

spaced: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਬਾ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੋੁਲਾਹਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
translation: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through the Perfect Guru.

spaced: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
translation: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.

spaced: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
translation: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings of Destiny! ||3||

spaced: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
translation: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
translation: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

spaced: ਏਕੋ ਪੜੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
translation: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other at all. ||4||

spaced: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
translation: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and the Sanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
translation: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the Dear Lord within their minds.

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੫॥
translation: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings in reincarnation are over. ||5||

spaced: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
translation: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, they do not attain liberation.

spaced: ਜਾ ਨਾਉ ਚੇਤੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
translation: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when the True Guru unites them in Union. ||6||

spaced: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love.

spaced: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ਚਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
translation: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

spaced: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||

spaced: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.

spaced: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
translation: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਸਹਜੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.

spaced: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
translation: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||

spaced: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.

spaced: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
translation: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
translation: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.

spaced: ਸਹਜੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
translation: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||

spaced: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
translation: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.

spaced: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
translation: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ਸਚ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
translation: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
translation: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.

spaced: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
translation: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||

spaced: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
translation: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.

spaced: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
translation: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.

spaced: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
translation: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||

spaced: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
translation: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.

spaced: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?

spaced: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
translation: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||

spaced: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
translation: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.

spaced: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.

spaced: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
translation: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||

spaced: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
translation: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
translation: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||

spaced: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
translation: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.

spaced: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
translation: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੯॥
translation: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

spaced: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
translation: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
translation: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

spaced: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੀਏ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੬॥੨੩॥
translation: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.

spaced: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
translation: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

spaced: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
translation: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||

spaced: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
translation: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.

spaced: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

spaced: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
translation: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
translation: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||

spaced: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
translation: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.

spaced: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
translation: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||

spaced: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
translation: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

spaced: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੫॥
translation: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

spaced: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.

spaced: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
translation: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

spaced: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
translation: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.

spaced: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
translation: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਇ ॥
translation: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.

spaced: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੪॥
translation: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24||

spaced: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

spaced: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

spaced: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
translation: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

spaced: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
translation: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

spaced: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
translation: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.
